changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Sesiones de usuario (ARC-112): emision, vigencia absoluta y revocacion server-side
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE sesion_usuario ( session_id VARCHAR2(36 CHAR), user_id NUMBER NOT NULL, role_code VARCHAR2(32 CHAR) NOT NULL, issued_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, expires_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL, last_activity_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, permissions_refreshed_at TIMESTAMP(6), revoked_at TIMESTAMP(6), revocation_reason VARCHAR2(30 CHAR), last_seen_at GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(last_activity_at AS TIMESTAMP(6))) VIRTUAL, revocation_cause GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(UPPER(revocation_reason) AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR))) VIRTUAL, CONSTRAINT pk_sesion_usuario PRIMARY KEY (session_id), CONSTRAINT fk_sesion_usuario_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id), CONSTRAINT fk_sesion_usuario_role FOREIGN KEY (role_code) REFERENCES cat_rol (role_code) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Reglas de coherencia de la sesion: enumerado de revocacion, vigencia y formato uuid
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE sesion_usuario ADD CONSTRAINT ck_sesion_usuario_reason_enum CHECK (revocation_reason IS NULL OR revocation_reason IN ('logout','expired','admin','password_change','account_deactivated'))
ALTER TABLE sesion_usuario ADD CONSTRAINT ck_sesion_usuario_revocacion CHECK ((revoked_at IS NULL AND revocation_reason IS NULL) OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revocation_reason IS NOT NULL))
ALTER TABLE sesion_usuario ADD CONSTRAINT ck_sesion_usuario_vigencia CHECK (expires_at > issued_at)
ALTER TABLE sesion_usuario ADD CONSTRAINT ck_sesion_usuario_actividad CHECK (last_activity_at >= issued_at AND (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= issued_at))
ALTER TABLE sesion_usuario ADD CONSTRAINT ck_sesion_usuario_id_uuid CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(session_id, '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE sesion_usuario DROP CONSTRAINT ck_sesion_usuario_id_uuid
ALTER TABLE sesion_usuario DROP CONSTRAINT ck_sesion_usuario_actividad
ALTER TABLE sesion_usuario DROP CONSTRAINT ck_sesion_usuario_vigencia
ALTER TABLE sesion_usuario DROP CONSTRAINT ck_sesion_usuario_revocacion
ALTER TABLE sesion_usuario DROP CONSTRAINT ck_sesion_usuario_reason_enum
